description: This file declares functions for miscellaneous operations in the RTL8367C switch driver, such as MAC address settings, debug info retrieval, port jam mode, and maximum length configurations.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicDebugInfo
methods.description: Retrieves debug information for a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Configures the jam mode on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortJamMode
methods.description: Retrieves the jam mode configuration of a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Sets the maximum length configuration for a specified configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLengthCfg
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum length configuration for a specified configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum length for a specific port and type, associated with a configuration ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum length setting for a specific port and type.
